_comment: Tier-2 for dune::poisson (advertised-but-absent companion packages). The DUNE catalog advertised dune-fem-dg DG operators/SSP-RK steppers and dune-vem VEM spaces as backend capabilities. Neither is importable from a conda-forge dune-fem 2.12.0.2 env: 'import dune.femdg', 'import dune.fem.dg' and 'import dune.vem' all raise ModuleNotFoundError, as does 'import dune.fem.solver'. dune.alugrid, dune.fem.view, dune.fem.utility and dune.fem.operator ARE importable, and dune.fem.parameter is reachable as an ATTRIBUTE of dune.fem while the module import fails. No grid, no space, no JIT — this fixture runs in under a second. Verified by execution against dune-fem 2.12.0.2 on 2026-08-03. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 probes an installed module (dune.grid) in the slot where dune.femdg is probed, i.e. the world in which dune-fem-dg IS present. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'dune_femdg_importable=False', 'dune_companion_module_inventory_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
